newsitem.title: USA: Colonial to buy all US Computer stock.
newsitem.headline: Colonial to buy all US Computer stock.

text.p: Colonial Commercial Corp said Wednesday it signed a non-binding memorandum of intent to buy all the outstanding stock of US Computer Group for 1,875,000 shares of Colonial common stock.
Colonial said it also intended to buy certain obligations of the company by issuing 750,000 warrants to purchase Colonial common stock at $1.25 per share and $1,000,000 in cash and notes.
US Computer Group offers maintenance for large computer companies and leading brands of personal computers, reporting revenues of $22 million in fiscal year ended 1996.
